Name: Iridium Scythe Recolor
Author: DuosAngel
Description:
So I recently ungraded all of my tools to iridium level, and man did that plain scythe look lame next to them. I went looking for a recolor of the scythe but didn't find what I was looking for. So I did it myself!

I used the same palette as the iridium pickaxe and I think it came out well enough for a quick and dirty recolor job. This didn't take very long so if anyone has a request/suggestion of other recolors you'd like, I'll try my best to make it happen.

(Also, YO! FIRST FILE UPLOADED TO NEXUS!)

Downloads.Description: A scythe recolor to match the iridium tools.
